final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---------------- bias ----------------
* ibias: diode-connected NMOS, sinks IREF (2 uA, sourced by testbench)
Mb    ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=0.5
* tail current source: 3 x IREF = 6 uA (3 uA per input device)
Mtail ntail ibias vss vss nfet W=6 L=0.5

* ---------------- preamp (inverting vinp -> n1) ----------------
* PMOS mirror load; balance point ~1.0 V at n1
M1    n1    vinp  ntail vss nfet W=6 L=0.3
M2    nd    vinn  ntail vss nfet W=6 L=0.3
M3    nd    nd    vdd   vdd pfet W=1.0 L=0.3
M4    n1    nd    vdd   vdd pfet W=1.0 L=0.3

* ---------------- INV1: threshold ~0.95 V (Wp/Wn ~ 1.6), input n1 ----------------
MpI1  n2    n1    vdd   vdd pfet W=0.8 L=0.15
MnI1  n2    n1    vss   vss nfet W=0.5 L=0.15

* ---------------- INV2 (driver), Wp/Wn ~ 1.6 ----------------
MpI2  n3    n2    vdd   vdd pfet W=0.8 L=0.15
MnI2  n3    n2    vss   vss nfet W=0.5 L=0.15

* ---------------- output inverter, sized for 50 fF load ----------------
MpB   vout  n3    vdd   vdd pfet W=3   L=0.15
MnB   vout  n3    vss   vss nfet W=1.5 L=0.15
.ends
